columns.name: url
columns.description: Their LinkedIn profile or company page. Empty for a name they typed until the teammate finds it.

columns.name: bucket
columns.description: voices: big reach in their topics. deciders: buy, hire or back. news: write about it first. builders: shipping in their space. peers: doing what they do.

columns.name: cadence
columns.description: How often they post, from their last 5 posts.

columns.name: why
columns.description: One line: why they're in this world, or why they're suggested.

columns.name: source
columns.description: you (named or added by the person), map (the first map), replied (replied to them or engaged twice), repeat (turned up in 2+ runs), linkedin (LinkedIn's "More profiles for you"), import (moved from the old list).

columns.name: removed_reason
columns.description: inactive (no post in 30 days), you (they removed them), not_now (they passed on a suggestion).

columns.name: last_seen_at
columns.description: The last finding run that came across them.

columns.name: seen_count
columns.description: How many finding runs came across them (posts with replies, or LinkedIn's suggestions next to watched people).

columns.name: decided_at
columns.description: When the person added, removed or passed on them.
